items.claim: Gage Young is durable and known for his toughness.
items.quote: Gage Young is durable... he is insanely tough.

items.claim: Gage Young is not the cleanest or most technical striker.
items.quote: I would argue he's not like the cleanest, most technical striker in the world

items.claim: Gage Young incorporates takedowns into his skill set, recording three takedowns in the Mahashete fight.
items.quote: He'll work in some takedowns as well. You can see he had three takedowns in that Mahashete fight.

items.claim: Gage Young went the full three rounds and landed 81 significant strikes in his short notice UFC debut loss to Evan Elder.
items.quote: he was there for three full rounds. Landed 81 significant strikes against basically who he considered a big brother.

items.claim: Gage Young has a visible cut and swelling under his right eye going into the fight.
items.quote: Gage Young also has some weird cut and swelling under his right eye.
